name: Antiguan Creole
confidence_why: The only grammar, Farquhar 1975, is visible just in short snippets that show word stress exists (numeral /wan/ stressed against the unstressed article, one main stress per compound) but give no placement rule, Galarza Ballester's thesis adds only that the syllable with a palatal glide is stressed, and Aceto & Williams 2004 describe the Eastern Caribbean in general, so where Antiguan stress falls,…
